podview.title: PodView wall screen
podview.description: Settings for the PodView panel. They reach the screen without restarting Home Assistant.

data_description.default_area: The room PodView opens in when the address names none (/podview/<area>). Unset: the room with both a speaker and lights, else the one with the most.
data_description.photo_album_url: Ro shows the photos of this shared album: the link from Photos › Share › Copy Link (https://photos.icloud.com/shared/album/…). Without a link Ro shows its own photo.

abort.admin_required: An active Home Assistant administrator must open and complete this flow.

error.old_album_link: This is an old shared album link (#B0…) that Apple no longer shows. Open the album in Photos, choose Share › Copy Link and paste the new link (https://photos.icloud.com/shared/album/…).
error.invalid_album_link: The link is not a shared iCloud album. It must start with https://photos.icloud.com/shared/album/.
